## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is the alternative recension of [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's *[Pǔxián xíngyuàn xiūzhèng yí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0152)* (X1472), preserved as a parallel-but-distinct version in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1473). The two versions document slightly different transmission lines of the same essential ritual material.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1067 – 1088) reflects [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's mature editorial activity. The parallel transmission of two versions of the same work is itself a piece of evidence for the active liturgical use of the *Pǔxián xíngyuàn* material in Northern-Sòng Huáyán-school monastic practice.
